name: Guess I'll Die
look: A stock photo of an older man with white hair and a short white beard in a red turtleneck sweater. He shrugs with both palms turned up, eyebrows raised and mouth flat, against a plain white background.
use: Someone hits a problem whose only fix is something they won't or can't do, and shrugs it off with deadpan resignation. The top caption sets up the problem and the bottom usually reads "guess I'll die".
slots: the problem with an unwelcome fix (top)
the shrugging give-up line, usually "guess I'll die" (bottom)
examples: The only cure is drinking more water, but I hate the taste of water
The pizza place is closed and I never learned to cook
describe: old man shrugging in a red sweater
elderly guy with a white beard holding his palms up
grandpa in a red turtleneck shrugs like oh well
senior man with gray hair shrugging on a white background
old dude with hands out and a blank face giving up
origin: A stock photo of a shrugging older man, paired with the deadpan phrase "guess I'll die".
